$comment: Residual cause census for the committed ACTIVITY oracle corpus, RE-CENSUSED by activity-swimlane-rendering T7 (2026-09-09) after landing T1-T6 (swimlane skinparams, content-fitted lane widths, lane placement, divider-and-floating-title chrome). The prior re-census was activity-style-defaults T7. Every number is a pure function of the committed corpus at measuredAgainstCommit: each of the 268 status:"baseline" fixtures in diff-baseline.json is rendered through render-fixture-activity.ts#renderFixtureActivity with a DeterministicMeasurer and fixtureIncludeStore(), and compared with compareSvg(ours, golden, 'deterministic'). Paths are normalised by replacing every positional index with [], so svg/g[1]/rect[3]/@x and svg/g[1]/rect[7]/@x are one family. RANKED BY WEIGHT, NOT COUNT. The narrative sections (exitBarFamilies, geometryResidual, childCountResidual, namedFamilies) are carried forward from the prior census unchanged except where restated below; paths and topFixturesByWeight are fresh. RE-COMPUTED by activity-min-box-width T6 (2026-09-09) from the same measurement as diff-baseline.json: aggregate 43977.

descent.note: The activity-min-box-width headline. Before = 48291, the figure activity-swimlane-rendering T7 pinned (8aad71eb) and which this mission stated its exit bar against. After = this measurement, post T0-T5 (+ the T4 fix commits). The unsourced 120px action-box floor is gone (FtileBox.java:237-243; unset MinimumWidth = 0, ValueNull.java:61-63), the box/diamond/hexagon stroke is the element tier 0.5 (plantuml.skin:91-93), every activity text is the root FontColor black (plantuml.skin:9) or a theme root override, and every text is positioned by x with no text-anchor (FtileBox.java:220-233, SheetBlock1.java:154-193 per line). ONE fixture rose and was adopted with its mechanism (simuti-16-lece058 217 -> 219: routing/gconnection-side-then-vertical-then-side.ts:6 tests from.x === to.x with exact float equality; at text-fitted branch widths the bar centre and the middle branch centre differ by one ulp, so a zero-length horizontal <line> is emitted and the arrowhead turns horizontal -- simuti carries two such segments and xenofo-81-rame803 carried two at T2 (since re-routed under T5); five other fixtures gained one legitimate elbow each where the floor had coincidentally aligned a branch centre; filed).

exitBarFamilies.note: The families activity-min-box-width named as DIRECTLY attributable (README exit bar: rect/@width 821, text/@text-anchor 1253, text/@fill 1288, rect/@stroke-width 846; text/@x 1427 as the placement corollary), restated against this re-pin. Weights sum every path ending in the family suffix over the 268 fixtures; the README figures were the g-scoped subset. text[]/@x barely moves because every activity x still carries the 4 px root-margin offset (ours 12, jar 16; activity-canvas-margin), which the inset census in text-baseline.json separates from placement: OURS inset 10 on 906 of 917 boxed texts, jar 10 on 914 of 930. polygon[]/@stroke-width is the plain rhombus renderDiamond emitting no stroke width (jar 0.5), filed.

geometryResidual.note: Re-derived by activity-min-box-width T6 from style-baseline.json's canvases. Width was wider=168 / narrower=99 / equal=1 and is now wider=72 / narrower=194 / equal=2; height was shorter=198 / taller=69 / equal=1 and is now shorter=188 / taller=79 / equal=1. Deleting the 120px floor moved the width residual from systematically too WIDE toward too NARROW; the remaining constant is LAYOUT_MARGIN 12 against the jar's 16 (activity-canvas-margin, filed earlier).

childCountResidual.note: svg/g[][childCount]'s share of total weight is 44.7% after this mission (39.9% before it; 91.6% at the aeg T0). 201 of 268 fixtures still carry a root-group child-count mismatch. The remaining weight is missing content and the defects named in .agent-notes/aeg-T1-8-exceptions.md, plus the zero-length split-connector segments the routing helper's float-equality shortcut emits once branch widths are text-fitted (filed).

namedFamilies.finding: We resolve theme.colors.background to #FFFFFF where the jar resolves #1B1B1B, so the root style/background carries the wrong colour AND the background rect the jar paints under its own paintBackcolor guard (SvgGraphics.java:186-192) is correctly declined on our resolved white. The guard is faithful; its INPUT is wrong. Found by T5 while verifying the guard, handed to this census.
namedFamilies.correction: The T5 decision-journal entry names velodu-59-sada437 as a second instance of this family. It is NOT one: that fixture's golden is the jar's OWN graphical error page (green-on-black, PSystemError styling), it is pinned status:"jar-error" in diff-baseline.json, and it contributes no number to this census at all. Its #000000 background is the error page's, not a resolved theme. Verified at T6, not inherited. skinparam mode dark occurs on exactly ONE fixture in the whole 373-fixture corpus.

namedFamilies.finding: The only surviving root-attribute VALUE diff besides background. Source sets `skinparam preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid slice`; the jar emits that verbatim on the root, we emit the hardcoded default `none`. Not a missing attribute -- the document shell emits all 7 root attributes on all 268 fixtures (verified) -- an unported skinparam.

The only surviving svg/defs[1][childCount] diff, and the opposite of the pre-mission one: OUR defs is empty (0) and the JAR's holds 1 child. Source is `skinparam activity { BackgroundColor red-green }`; the jar expands the two-colour form into a <linearGradient> in defs and fills the rect with url(#...). We emit no gradient. Confirms the D6 change was right in general -- 267 of 268 goldens have an EMPTY defs, matching ours -- and isolates the one shape that needs it.
